label: car-red
anchorNote: Cell pixels, origin top-left. groundY = lowest tire pixel (sits on road). roof.left/right = ends of the top edge within tolerancePx of the highest roof pixel (landing surface). wheels = hub centres (rotation pivots, measured from the hub ring) and outer tire radius. Suggested origin (0.5, groundY/height).

provenance.generator: Sorceress nano-banana-2 (16:9, 1376x768 on #00FF00 chroma), ref approved-art-style.png
provenance.process: Corridor Key alpha at 1024x572; fully opaque pixels restored to original generation colours; alpha <6 cleared; green spill clamped; cropped to content + 24px padding. Recoloured in code from car-blue: only saturated blue body-paint pixels re-hued (131289 px); geometry, alpha, canvas, windows, tires, lights and outlines identical.

wheelLayer.placement: draw wheel.png centred on each anchors.wheels[i] centre (sprite pixels), scaled by scale, rotated by angle
wheelLayer.spin: angle(rad) -= distanceTravelledPx / (radius * spriteDisplayScale); car faces left and drives left, so wheels turn counter-clockwise on screen
wheelLayer.note: Body PNG has the tire interior cut out (transparent within radius-5 of each centre); the outer tire outline ring stays on the body so the seam is hidden. Without the wheel layer the body shows empty wheel holes.
